name: Lena
source:
The overprotective sister of her younger brother, she stopped pursuing her own interests and ended up liking the same things as he does. But that didn't change who she is, a kind and cheerful person, her words filled with passion. She got through an experience she won't forget, an attempt at love that was met by a heart that wanted to be left alone.

[From [url=https://twitter.com/innocenceversus/status/1022134987393589248] Twitter[/url]]
